source_title: Towards the Properties of Different Biomass-Derived Proteins via Various Extraction Methods
authors: Du; Arauzo; Meza Zavala; Cao; Olszewski; Kruse
feedstock: pasture grass cut to 2-3 cm and stored at -15 C
precipitation_and_recovery: 1 M TCA to pH 3.0; centrifuge 13500 x g at 4 C for 20 min; freeze then lyophilize
basis: dried precipitate mass / protein content in biomass x 100
limitations: Source-defined yield; not a commercial recovery coefficient. Protein content in biomass was estimated with N x 6.25 for extracts; fresh pasture grass comparator, not roadside grass.
